races.verdict: SON OF A FISH took his form up a notch when third on nursery debut at Leicester just over a fortnight ago and with better anticipated quickly returned up to 1m, Richard Hannon's colt gets the verdict. SON OF A FISH ASTRAL CALLING (IRE) HOPE OF ACKLAM

races.display_title: Bet With The Dewhurst Ring Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: A competitive handicap but MAGNOLIA has slipped to a lenient mark and with her yard going well she looks the way to go on her return from a break. Last year's winner Pure Gold seems primed for a big run and rates a big danger though, while in-form duo Follow Charlie and Annie Agnew can also play prominent roles. MAGNOLIA (FR) PURE GOLD FOLLOW CHARLIE (IRE)

races.verdict: This valuable event can go the way of James Fanshawe's TIKKA who looked an excellent prospect when scoring in fine style on her recent Kempton debut and can take this step up in class in her stride. Eabha brings some very strong Group-race form to the table and rates a big threat though. Fillipas can also play a prominent role with this step up to 7f looking a big plus, while Zigazig Ah , Lady Foxtrot and Flooding all command plenty of respect too in this cracking juvenile fillies' event. TIKKA EABHA (IRE) FILLIPAS (IRE)

races.display_title: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: No shortage of chances in a competitive fillies' handicaps with QUEBELLA shading preference. Lightly raced this season, she left the distinct impression a stronger tempo would have suited when fourth at Bath 3 weeks ago and, expected to come on for that run, she looks interesting on her first crack at this trip. Hope Rising continues to go from strength-to-strength and is a lead danger in search of the 5-timer with Kissmehoneyhoney another who likely has a bigger effort in her locker. QUEBELLA HOPE RISING (IRE) KISSMEHONEYHONEY

races.verdict: VICTORY SOUND ended a losing run at a lower level at Newcastle 3 weeks ago, yet he had enough in hand on that occasion to think he can be very competitive again following a token 2 lb rise and earns the vote. Spirit of Breeze highlighted his turn may be near when second at Lingfield recently and he's a major threat under David Egan. Last-time-out scorer Whitesnake remains unexposed at 1m and is another to consider despite a tricky draw. VICTORY SOUND (IRE) SPIRIT OF BREEZE (IRE) WHITESNAKE

races.verdict: A case can be made for lots of these but the vote goes to ARUNDEL who resumed from an absence with an encouraging Yarmouth third and can race off the same mark here with Billy Loughnane now in the saddle. Sansanetti heads the list of dangers on the back of a good Wolverhampton fourth, while Ghost Story , Kurios Lady and Ricardo Phillips can all have a say too. ARUNDEL (IRE) SANSANETTI (IRE) GHOST STORY (IRE)

races.verdict: LOVE ME TENDER may not have rewarded favourite backers in the Ebor last month, but Willie Mullins' German recruit shaped encouragingly and now with attentions quickly switched to hurdling, he gets the vote. Bud Fox is progressing gradually in this sphere and clearly with much more to come given his bumper form, he heads up the opposition, with Tyson Fury and Jules Winfield completing the shortlist. LOVE ME TENDER (GER) BUD FOX (IRE) TYSON FURY

races.verdict: COOLADDI is going the right way and is taken to reverse recent form with Smallcraftwarning and resume winning ways. Caher Roes Den won last time and rates the chief threat, with further improvement likely for Willie Mullins, while Hi Ho Idaho should be sharper for the recent outing and could improve upped in trip. COOLADDI (IRE) CAHER ROES DEN (IRE) HI HO IDAHO (IRE)

races.verdict: NOWWHATDOYOUTHINK shaped as if ahead of his mark behind King Alexander in the Galway Plate and is taken to prove it back at 3m at a track that should suit his style of racing better. Funiculi Funicula must bounce back but Paul Townend keeps the faith and his natural class makes him a big danger if staying the 3m trip. Recent Galway winner Kings Hill remains of interest, with both Conyers Hill and Spread Boss Ted also respected. NOWWHATDOYOUTHINK (IRE) FUNICULI FUNICULA (FR) KINGS HILL (IRE)

races.verdict: LA NOTE VERTE has progressed with each start over fences and is taken to follow up her recent Tramore success. Miss Doyenne won on chase debut and remains open to improvement, though she may prove best over further. LA NOTE VERTE LADY BLUEBIRD (IRE) MISS DOYENNE (IRE)

races.verdict: ROND POINT showed promise in a race that's working out well at Galway in July and is taken to become the latest to frank that form by making his second start under Rules a winning one.
